title: CI/CD
description: Generates GitHub Actions workflows: CI for the affected projects (lint, test, build), opt-in deploy workflows (Docker image to GHCR, Vercel prebuilt deploys) and an optional Dependabot configuration.

docker.description: Applications whose Docker image is built and pushed to ghcr.io after CI passes on the main branch. Runs next-feature:docker for apps without a Dockerfile.

vercel.description: Applications deployed to Vercel with the Vercel CLI (production after CI passes on the main branch, previews for pull requests), replacing Vercel's Git integration. Runs next-feature:vercel for apps without a vercel.json.

e2e.description: Add a CI job running the e2e target of the affected projects.

dependencyUpdates.description: Dependency update configuration: dependabot writes .github/dependabot.yml (packages, except Nx, and GitHub Actions, weekly).
